source: FIGURES.md adapted for clubs, 2026-09-25, as for the NYC, Tokyo, Budapest, Prague, Amsterdam and Ibiza guides. Live Google SERP for 'best clubs in manchester' (US, 2026-09-25). Current venue list and character notes: Resident Advisor, 'The Best Clubs in Manchester in 2026' (ra.co/guides/clubs-in-manchester, dated 7 January 2026). History: Wikipedia (The Haçienda; The Warehouse Project). Dress code, checked directly: nightclub.org.uk (The White Hotel: no dress code) and manchestertourism.org (Hidden, White Hotel, Warehouse Project: 'anything goes'). Selector catalogue (selector-data.json) searched for 'manchester' for the video embeds.

required_records.title: The Haçienda
required_records.why: S5 originators: the club that made Manchester's clubbing reputation, source of the city's acid house/Madchester scene; closed and demolished, so it is the page's history section rather than a table entry
required_records.photo_credit: a_marga, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons, taken 26 August 2007. The Flickr original is titled '24 Hour Party People' with the caption 'esto seguia estando cuando yo fui en el 91' (Spanish: 'this was still there when I went in [19]91'). The image shows an indoor display, not a street, and the dates line up with Urbis's 'Haçienda 25' exhibition (mid-July 2007 to mid-February 2008, per Wikipedia), but that venue is not confirmed by the file page itself, so the caption does not assert a specific current location
